summary: Adds space below the header on the organization picker.
userImpact: The organization picker has more space below the header on desktop and tighter spacing on narrow screens.
documentation: The organization picker uses responsive spacing from the application's Carbon scale.
rollback: Redeploy the previous compatible application images.
validation: Chromium checks the gap below the persistent header and horizontal reflow at desktop and narrow widths.

customerDocumentation.reason: The change adjusts the spacing of existing controls.
